Dazzle camouflage DOES work, but it works the same way zebra stripes work when they stand in a herd of zebras. The goal here is that it would make it harder to discern the outline of a ship when it was seen in front of other vessels or docks painted the same way, not when it was alone at sea. The auto industry still uses it today to make it harder to pick out prototype vehicles out of a parking lot.

Dazzle camo was not supposed to hide the ship, it was supposed to make it harder to hit because it's difficult to discern exactly where the ship is, it fucks with depth perception. Apparently it worked, the japs were missing shots left and right.
